Fashion & Cultural Influence

Signature Style

Flowing silk, delicate jewellery and sculptural gowns define Suky’s editorial style. Her portraits draw on the silhouettes of Chinese dress and the drama of contemporary haute couture.

Personal Philosophy

“I was never meant to belong to just one world.”

For Suky, elegance comes from staying open to different influences and having the courage to make them her own.
